question: Owner 2026-10-31 '同时去做试试看吧': retest the 1m entry score on the paper accounts with cuts rank-mapped onto the frozen scale and labels from the accounts' own exits; train before 2026, test 2026.
single_variable: Arms separate the two approved changes: m1_fixed -> m1_ranked (cuts only) -> m1_acct (cuts and label); base_acct is the 5m control for m1_acct and m1_shuf the 1m-feature null. Fills, rules, costs and sizing identical across arms.
approval: Two changes at once approved by the owner on 2026-10-31; arms report each step separately

labels.v3: v3 opposite 1.618 parent row (-30 percent, breakeven +0.17 percent, 60m); win = net > 0, worse path, 10bp slippage on non-target exits
labels.spike: spike row (near Monday edge, -18 percent, breakeven +0.17 percent, 60m), same win definition

rank_map: score -> frozen causal score at the same training-period rank (np.interp over both sorted columns of training events)
accounts: v3, v3add, v3add20, allin3 on the v3-label score; spike on the spike-label score with EMA order >= 3; rules and sizing as exp-monday-limit-paper-accounts-20261028-v1; v2 and v3lock not rerun
null_control: m1_shuf: 1m features permuted jointly across all events, refit and replayed (5 seeds); base_acct isolates the label change from the 1m features. Same fills for all arms, so no separate random entries; the matched-random question for these accounts is unchanged from 20261028.
in_sample: 2020-2025 is the training period for every refit arm; only 2026 is a test
